gate: AUD2 gaps 1 and 6, offline unit checks; no runtime gate passed

findings.before: keepLayer sent a small GeoJSON member to dependencies.retain inside fenced(); a 413/422 refusal reached notKept, so the member was noted 'not kept as its own original. Enrol the archive again to retry' and never read; a retry refused again
findings.after: retainMapLayer catches AppError 413/422 from retain and keeps the member through dependencies.retainMember (the byte receipt) with the same ArchiveMemberLineage, under its own fenced() revision read; any other error is rethrown unchanged (today's notKept words)

findings.before: ManualIngestionService.retain commits a geojson-manual-v1 row with the archiveMember lineage (keepManualOriginal) before its reader refuses, so after the fallback two rows share the lineage; a stop between the receipt and the link let linkKeptTx (ORDER BY created_at) link the refused row
findings.after: linkKeptTx skips a geojson-manual-v1 row without manualProfile, so a refused or unfinished map-route row is never linked as the member's child; a 503-interrupted row is finished by the next retain (same sha256 duplicate) instead of being linked half-done
findings.dependsOn: Removing the refused row itself depends on the other worker's keepManualOriginal change in service.ts (not edited here); until it lands each refused member leaves one unlinked geojson-manual-v1 row and moves the case revision once

findings.why: No existing field fits. The member row's limit_reason is cleared by linkTx and by enrolMember on success, and zipParentWords (intake-draft.ts, not owned) lists any member with a sourceId and a reason as 'kept, not read', which would be false; the child's own item words are written by its streaming reader. Recording it needs an owner of intake-draft.ts to let a fallback reason show beside a read member

findings.before: officeKind set kmz when any member probed as KML; queueZipLayersTx then returned early, so the other members were never taken out or named
findings.after: kmzShape: a KMZ is at least one KML document and every other member an image or COLLADA model a KML references (png, jpg, jpeg, gif, bmp, tif, tiff, dae), the KMZ layout the native reader expects (root doc.kml, else its only .kml); any other member keeps the archive a zip and the existing per-member fan-out takes out each member, the KML included

findings.note: The public libkml sample multikml-doc.kmz (E:/BhuAayam-data/task-data/desktop-kml-native/originals) probes as zip before and after: its four 42-byte .kml members are not recognised as KML by the probe, so it is not a check of this rule
